title: The Car Never Stops
hook: Five stars. Every cop in the city. And my car can't stop

messages.text: Neon Night. Five stars. Every cop in the city on his tail. And in Getaway Heat... your car never stops.
messages.label: NEON NIGHT

messages.text: All units, orange coupe heading north. Box him in!
Two patrol cars, one on each side. Jay waited... waited... then swerved. And they smashed right into each other.
Yes! Combo! Did you see that?!
Then the SWAT trucks showed up. Bigger. Faster. And they don't brake for anything.
Jay cut into an alley barely wider than his car. Sparks on both doors. The trucks couldn't follow. He was almost clear...
Until the end of the alley. Where a tank was waiting.
A TANK?! Since when are there TANKS?!
Your car never stops. So Jay didn't. He floored it under the barrel... and the shot flew over him. Straight into every cop behind him.
Combo times twelve. The sun came up over Palm Beach, and Jay was finally free. Or was he? Because the helicopter... was back.
messages.label: PALM BEACH · 6:02 AM

messages.text: This is Getaway Heat. Free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game, so play it on a computer. How long can you last?
